ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient onboarding and preliminary symptom triage platform designed specifically for local RGPV campus clinics to reduce queue congestion.
ideas.title: ArogyaSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Healthcare track and solves an administrative pain point local student judges experience firsthand.

ideas.pitch: Secure prescription and medical record summarizer that translates complex doctor prescriptions and lab reports into simplified Hindi and English for rural patients.
ideas.title: MedVault AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses regional accessibility challenges in healthcare, aligning with social impact priorities often favored by university judges.

ideas.pitch: Automated first-aid and mental health initial assessment routing agent optimized for student wellness centers during high-stress exam periods.
ideas.title: CampusCare Triage

ideas.pitch: Mess menu nutrition tracker and personalized meal advisor that optimizes student diets based on affordable local mess and canteen food options.
ideas.title: NutriCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of targeted nutritional tools by solving an everyday financial and health problem for college students.
